name: ingredient-list
title: Ingredient list
description: A recipe's ingredients that scale: change the servings and the amounts follow, as kitchen fractions or metric decimals, with lines you can tick off.
docs: ingredients are lines with an id, name, quantity, unit, note and group, written for baseServings. A numeric quantity scales with the servings; a string quantity ('a pinch', 'a handful') stays as written, and scales: false keeps a number fixed. A line with no quantity is a name with a note ('maple syrup, to taste'). Cups, spoons, ounces and pounds are written as kitchen fractions ('1 1/2 cups') and never as decimals: an amount snaps to the nearest eighth or third (a tie goes up, and 1/8 is the least), counted things come in quarters, and a name with a plural takes it ('1 egg', '3 eggs'); grams and millilitres are decimals that roll over to kilograms and litres at a thousand. Units pluralise through Intl.PluralRules by the amount as it is written ('1 cup', '2 cups', and '3/4 cup' stays singular), the metric and imperial ones take the locale's own short form, and units lets you add words or translate them. servings is controlled with onServingsChange or uncontrolled with defaultServings; the stepper is the kit's number input, and Reset appears after a change. checkable adds a checkbox to each line: a ticked line is struck through and stays where it is, the count ('2 of 9 ticked') is a polite live region, and Clear ticks empties them; checked, defaultChecked and onCheckedChange control which. Lines with the same group sit under one heading, and the amounts line up in one column across groups. labels carries every word.
